purpose: Prospective independent empirical replication of the frozen v0.4-R5b activity/state decomposition after the first Snapshot Japan endpoint terminated on a temporal-integrity rule.

prior_evidence_used_only_to_define_e2_ru.interpretation: The E2 temporal adjudication rule is prospectively frozen from prior audits and is not a reinterpretation of the first empirical endpoint.

selection_basis: independent camera-trap study/package from Snapshot Japan and AWD pilot2
public Camtrap DP version 3 with deployments, observations and media resources
geographic scope spans Belgium and Germany and therefore permits response-blind strict east-gap qualification
muskrat is an explicit project target and taxonomic-scope species, allowing focal-taxon selection without response-frequency inspection

rejected_metadata_only_alternative.reason: public issue metadata reports 211 observations with missing eventStart; E2 requires zero unparseable/missing event timestamps, so temporal failure is predictable before any new response opening

candidate_selection.previously_attempted_but_unopened_datase: A dataset whose response rows were never opened may remain scientifically eligible in E2, but MICA is selected instead to avoid inheriting Snapshot USA transport history.
candidate_selection.required_independence: different camera-trap study/package from every dataset whose observation rows have already been opened by the esdm empirical programme
allowed_before_candidate_freeze: observations resource schema or header only
file sizes, checksums and transport metadata
candidate_selection.focal_taxon_rule: A candidate-specific child contract must name one focal mammal from publication/metadata grounds before any observation data row is opened. Selection from observed response abundance is forbidden.

east_holdout_rule.candidate_cuts: every strict gap between unique deployment longitudes leaving at least 50 training deployments west and at least 12 heldout deployments east
east_holdout_rule.selection: largest longitude gap; ties choose the easternmost cut
east_holdout_rule.integrity: min heldout longitude > max training longitude

temporal_integrity_stage.timing: after candidate child contract and response-blind geometry/header receipt are frozen and authorized, but before scientificName/count/state values are read

prospective_quarantine_rule.applies_to: unique event-level animal event identities across the whole candidate package, before focal-taxon filtering
prospective_quarantine_rule.action: freeze qualifying event identities into a quarantine set; exclude those identities from every ecological stream without extending deployment effort

stop_conditions: any event occurs before deployment start
any animal event has missing deployment identity
any required event timestamp is unparseable
prohibited_repairs: post-response changes to the 0.5% candidate-level fraction

streams: opportunistic PresenceOnly-like count stream with unknown effort component
calibrated PresenceOnly-like count stream with explicit deployment effort
state-annotated count stream consuming suitability, activity and state
direct conditional state-composition calibration stream consuming state only
frozen_r5b_information_architecture.climate_source_rule: The candidate-specific precipitation source and extraction receipt must be frozen before full response opening; response-conditioned feature search is forbidden.

empirical_interpretation.activity_process_predictive_support: activity gain > 0 with acceptable fit diagnostics
empirical_interpretation.state_process_predictive_support: state gain > 0 with acceptable fit diagnostics
